units.sigma_omega: always label s^-1, normalized by H, or normalized by Theta; never mix
units.acceleration: A physical acceleration; A/c contributes inverse time
units.gaia: microarcsecond/year response coefficients; not direct sigma/H

component_contract.operator: Every model has a finite predict(theta,nu) -> same ordered carrier shape (p,). Response must be from stated physical derivation or labeled working-model only.

gaussian_law.formula: logL=-0.5*(r^T C(theta,nu)^-1 r + logdet C(theta,nu)+p log(2pi))
gaussian_law.validity: One shared carrier may have both mean and covariance dependence. No second independent factor for the same data.
gaussian_law.implementation: Cholesky solve and log diagonals. Finite symmetric SPD validation; no automatic epsilon jitter, pseudoinverse, or covariance discard. If singular by construction, explicitly use a fixed support with its induced measure.
gaussian_law.mode_order: Match standard_lowell_mode_labels or explicit alternative release contract, including real/imag and E/B convention.

finite_mc_law.when: Only iid Gaussian, same observable process, sample covariance S with N independent realizations, and compatible covariance prior; N>p. No automatic use with rescaled, shrunk, correlated or fitted residual mocks.
finite_mc_law.alternate: If assumptions fail, preregister shrinkage/hierarchical model and heldout calibration; do not merely relabel as calibrated.
finite_mc_law.rank_and_precision: Record N, p, effective ensemble dependence, eigenvalues, regularization and coverage. Hartlap factor alone is not a posterior covariance model.

compression.baseline: Raw normal equation or full harmonic likelihood with identical selection, prior, nuisance and stochastic law.
compression.target: Specify estimand or competing model before selecting compression.
compression.exact_fixed_gaussian: F,t under nuisance projection. Signed x=(F,t) retains specified likelihood ratios. Invertible tensor chart ties correct GLS/score.
compression.scalar: Report target-specific score/Fisher/likelihood loss; dimension ratios and posterior covariance ranks are not information loss.
compression.nonlinear: Use validation grid and heldout parameter injections; do not extrapolate local score equality to global posterior/model evidence.
compression.monte_carlo: Choose coverage precision from binomial uncertainty and available heldout N before inspection; report interval even when all replicates pass.

null_contract.statistic: Same observed and simulated estimator, parameter definition, nuisance fit, masks, selection, scale, source combination and posterior/MAP summary.
null_contract.forbidden: a_lm slices times empirical constants; Gaussian draws from arbitrary widths; prior draws renamed matched null
null_contract.finite_tail: For exchangeable fixed statistic use (k+1)/(N+1) with binomial/MC uncertainty; record raw k,N. Posterior exceedance and frequentist calibrated tail are separate.
null_contract.unavailable: No BETA_MO_MATCHED_NULL output until actual same-estimator replicated joint datasets are available.

local_input_access.source: Existing owned-data inventory + exact local path inspection
local_only: full catalogue source rows and pipeline caches
local_input_access.avoid_rehash: Reuse accepted source identities; rehash only new/changed exact frozen files or provenance conflicts.

output_contract.arrays: npz allow_pickle=False, finite numerical arrays, explicit axis labels and shapes, no object arrays
output_contract.json: strict JSON: null for unavailable scalars, never NaN/Infinity; no fabricated evidence
output_contract.large_products: Store data/chains locally and commit compact summary and manifest. Do not upload catalogues or maps.

review_sequence: Implement source-derived repair in assigned paths
One independent scoped review and targeted fixes
Non-force push and verify exact remote commit

scientific_quarantine.historical_R49: Preserve receipt bytes but do not use invalid beta-null Pi, 13/14 information-loss or physical 24D posterior as science evidence.
still_open: R49 five-view frame/epoch tag and assumed depth transport
scientific_quarantine.not_required: PR4 NPIPE, new catalogues, a native full Bianchi solver before publishing scoped observed-methods results.
